supported_guidance.guidance: inspect history and reflog before selecting a recovery commit
inspect and resolve conflict then stage and complete merge
verify status and resulting history before completion
pager and newline interactions can block subsequent commands

material_difference: New guide distinguishes demonstrated recovery from cautious alternatives, explains why checks matter, gives explicit failure/stop boundaries and cites raw steps; old guide is eight numbered rules without linked evidence.
limitations: One historical task does not support cross-task generalization or causal claims.
New guide still uses numbered subsections; removing forced numbered output is not evidence that lists vanish.
Stash, cherry-pick and additional diff commands are marked unobserved cautious advice, not validated methods.
The statement that output ending with a colon is a pager is overbroad; the raw trace supports only the concrete pager encounter.
Some references point to original card narration; raw tool observations take precedence.
Empty generated resources validate the no-gratuitous-resource case, not live resource execution.
No manual modification of either generated artifact.
evaluation_intent: Four bounded autonomous executions check save-load-use mechanism only; no score-driven iteration.
